name: enfantil
description: Enfantil — Infant and Maternal Health Management System: API (backend), family app (frontend/enfantil) and clinician portal (client/clinician).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/enfantil && npm install --prefix client/clinician
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run setup --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,family,portal --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/enfantil" "npm run dev --prefix client/clinician"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend/enfantil && npm run build --prefix client/clinician
